|lore=Based in the Roche Asteroid Field. Worked with Admiral Ackbar to develop the B-wing fighter. Verpine owned, and that means quality.
|game_text=Deploy on Roche system. Once during each of your deploy phases, you may deploy a starship weapon from Reserve Deck on your B-wing; reshuffle. Also, retrieve 2 Force whenever your starfighter or vehicle 'hits' an opponent's starship or vehicle. (Immune to Alter.)
|joke="…owned, and that means quality" has the ring of an advertising slogan, as if the B-wing's makers were selling cars. Real advertising used the same form: the 1953 Old Spice jingle has "'Old Spice means quality,' said the Captain to the Bosun",<ref name="neatorama-jingles">[https://www.neatorama.com/2015/02/20/Jingle-Fever-the-Stories-Behind-Ad-Jingles/ Jingle Fever: The Stories Behind 5 Ad Jingles], Neatorama (20 February 2015). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027131154/https://www.neatorama.com/2015/02/20/Jingle-Fever-the-Stories-Behind-Ad-Jingles/ Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.</ref> and a 1952 Alligator coat advertisement says "It's Alligator, of course, and that means quality."<ref name="statesman-1952">[https://oregonnews.uoregon.edu/lccn/sn85042470/1952-10-10/ed-1/seq-4/ocr/ ''The Oregon Statesman'' (Salem), 10 October 1952, page 4], Historic Oregon Newspapers. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027124604/https://oregonnews.uoregon.edu/lccn/sn85042470/1952-10-10/ed-1/seq-4/ocr/ Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.</ref> Later ads used it too: a 1976 Buick ad ("Regal is a Buick. And that means quality.")<ref name="callpost-1976-buick">[https://archive.org/details/columbuscallpost63lync_14 ''Call and Post'' (Columbus, Ohio), 17 April 1976, page 14A] (Buick Regal advertisement, "You've earned it."), Internet Archive.</ref> and a 1987 Trane ad ("it's made by Trane. And that means quality.").<ref name="achrnews-1987-trane">[https://archive.org/details/micro_IA40706924_0238 ''Air Conditioning, Heating & Refrigeration News'', 6 April 1987] (Trane XL 1200 advertisement), Internet Archive.</ref> See [[Jokes#Slayn & Korpil Facilities|Jokes]].
